status: Qualified source-exact native CUDA frequency tables and automatic model-configured attention forward. Engram, whole-model generation admission and vLLM parity remain open.

implementation.metadata: Architecture resolves main/compressed family settings and double correction bounds. Model adapter exposes resolved scalar metadata to transformer. FE_TONEAREST required; helper preserves caller rounding mode and output on rejection.
implementation.arithmetic: F32 exponent multiplication by rounded reciprocal dimension, libdevice powf, rounded F32 reciprocal/pooling operations. YaRN ramp uses F32(1.0 / DOUBLE width), avoiding inverse(F32 width). Preserve both1-minus stages, separately rounded products and addition; negative table exact sign negation. No magnitude/attention factor folded into frequencies.
implementation.compiler: Dedicated CUDA translation unit without fast-math, preserving the existing fast-math rotation translation unit and all existing rotation behavior.
implementation.ownership: Four additional request-owned read-only F32 tables: main/compressed and their negatives.512 extra payload bytes for the actual64-dimensional profile, four additional allocation sites. Generated once transactionally during producer setup, with existing final setup completion before publication.
implementation.execution: Automatic forward selects family using architecture compression ratio and calls the qualified full attention producer. No frequency allocation/generation/upload/readback during forward. Explicit-table entry point retained. No new whole-model admission.

references.method: Unchanged original util/rope.py yarn_inv_freq AST under Torch CUDA;333 primary/negative/diagnostic cases. Companion scalar metadata derives double correction bounds and reciprocal from source settings, not candidate outputs.
references.coverage: Plain and YaRN, rotary dimensions4/6/8/10/32/64/80/96/128/256/512/2048, three bases, factors1/2/16/64, truncation variants, fractional parameters and collapsed correction bounds.
references.checkpoint: Both actual tables equal preserved original QKV frequency oracles bit-for-bit. Existing synthetic and actual-weight producer-chain oracles reused unchanged; generated table views and outputs compared after automatic forward.
